title: Kaashmora
desc: Kaashmora, a fraudster, gets locked inside a haunted bungalow, along with his clan. Soon, the family faces an army of ghosts who will let them leave only if their wishes are granted.

title: Loud Speaker
desc: An uneducated and noisy simpleton, Mike Philippose, arrives in a city as an organ donor for an old astrophysicist. Soon, he changes the lives of everyone around him.

title: Sivakasi
desc: Muthappa is forced to leave his house at a young age for a crime that his older brother, Udayappa, has committed. When he returns home, he learns about his brother's antics and decides to punish him.

title: Dada
desc: Manikandan, a young boy, endures many hardships and faces the challenges of raising a son as a single parent after accidentally impregnating his lover.

title: Mersal
desc: Maaran, a doctor, is falsely arrested for the murder of his colleague, Dr Arjun Zachariah. He soon discovers that the real culprit is a lookalike who aims to expose corruption in the medical industry.
